correctness.rationale: In the induced rank-[1,3] Boolean Hamming scale-two flag complex, a singleton is adjacent to a higher-rank support exactly when included; pair families form Johnson cliques. The first Morse matching along smallest common singleton removes every higher-support family with nonempty intersection. Remaining critical candidates are the three 2-subsets of each triple, the cone with its triple, and four triples of each four-set; second matching cancels triangle-to-cone. Directed cycles are excluded by nonincrease of number of rank-two vertices and forced strict drop after second-stage arrows. Critical cells are one vertex and binom(n,4) 3-cells. Cross-polytope sphere z_U pairs with an ambient maximal-triple cocycle C_U by a diagonal integral unit, making a primitive integral basis; coordinate permutations produce exterior-fourth-power signs. Inspected full RESULT and structural verifier; independently enumerated full mod-two reduced ranks for n=3,4,5, confirming 0,1,5 top generators. Those finite enumerations are corroboration, not the uniform proof.
